summary.text: Joseph McLaughlin is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat D. Michael Ray.
He was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2022 and 2024, losing the general election both times.

paragraphs.text: Joseph McLaughlin ran in the 2022 general election for Maine House District 40 as the Republican nominee and lost to incumbent Democrat Stanley Zeigler, 58.7 percent to 41.3 percent.
In the 2024 general election for the same district, he lost to Democrat D. Michael Ray, 54.4 percent to 45.6 percent.
McLaughlin advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and faces Ray, now the incumbent, in the general election.
